title: [spec-gap][R-11-050] /messages legacy alias registered and advertised in /.well-known/core contrary to MUST NOT (spec 17.5.7)
description: Spec 17.5.7: The legacy Python demo /messages resource is not part of LCI and MUST NOT be advertised as a native messaging resource. Classification: divergent. Evidence: python/src/lichen/coap/resources/site.py:251-257 registers LegacyMessagesAliasResource unconditionally alongside /msg/*; messaging.py:606-621 alias delegates POST to inbox and mirrors Observe; discovery advertises </messages>;rt=legacy.messages (test_messages_resource.py:94-104 pins the advertisement). Arguably compliant-labeling (distinct rt, title=legacy demo alias) but the letter of the MUST NOT says it must not be advertised. Suggested placement: drop the /messages registration from build_site() default (or gate behind an explicit legacy-compat opt-in flag) and update test_messages_resource.py accordingly. python/tests/coap/test_messages_resource.py and site.py:257.
